skill.name: rust-best-practices
skill.description: Rust development best practices, patterns, and conventions. Use when writing Rust code, reviewing .rs files, discussing ownership, lifetimes, borrowing, or Cargo configuration. Triggers on mentions of Rust, Cargo, ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, async Rust, tokio.

edit_instructions.target_text:
### Custom Error Types
```rust
use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum AppError {
    #[error("database error: {0}")]
    Database(#[from] sqlx::Error),

    #[error("not found: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),

    #[error("validation error: {field}")]
    Validation { field: String },
}
```
edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the custom error types section eliminates the key pattern for creating a custom Result type with thiserror, which the user explicitly requests for validation errors.
Deleting the builder pattern section removes the canonical example of building configuration with a builder, which the user wants to use for input path and output format.
